name: Harmoglyph
description: Sheet-to-synth-to-vector pipeline stitching an A1:F48 Excel-style formula spreadsheet VM, 4 mathematical foundations (Harmonic Sine, Fibonacci, Golden Ratio φ, Pythagorean), a 2-operator Web Audio FM synthesizer with offline 16-bit PCM .wav export, and a bidirectional parametric SVG/PNG vector plotter.

safetyGuarantees: Cycle detection via active visiting set terminating with #CYCLE!

stage2_fmSynthesizer.topology: 2-operator FM (foundation-scaled modulator -> modGain -> carrier.frequency -> lowpass biquad -> exponential gain -> masterGain 0.28 -> AnalyserNode)

exports.liveAudio: Web Audio API step sequencer (60-180 BPM eighth-note grid across 4 voices)
exports.offlineWav: 22.05 kHz 16-bit mono PCM with 44-byte RIFF/WAVE/fmt/data header

stage3_vectorPlotter.projection: Just-intonation interval ratio (p:q) & math-foundation coupled Harmonograph, Euler Pitch Spiral, Chladni Mandala, FM Ribbon, and inverse geometryToFormulaGrid compiler
